title: Cancel changes nothing, all-fail keeps the selection, no parts is refused
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission (needed to change status/tracking).
custom_steps:
1. Open a confirmation and Cancel; check no part changed status.
  2. Run a bulk change where every part fails; check the list and selection.
  3. Send a status change with no parts selected; read the message.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • If the user cancels the confirmation, no part changes status.
  • If every part in a bulk change fails, the list stays on screen and the selection is kept so the user can retry; a status change sent with no parts selected is refused with "Select at least one part."

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 10 (Confirming & recording a status change); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-N1: “If the user cancels the confirmation, no part changes status.”
  • S10-N2: “If every part in a bulk change fails, the list stays on screen and the selection is kept so the user can retry.”
  • S10-N3: “If a status change is sent with no parts selected, it is refused with the message "Select at least one part."”
